create_elmo_token_embedder: create an ElmoTokenEmbedder instance with a FairseqLanguageModel to learn task-specific word representations
run_elmo_forward_pass: run a forward pass through ElmoTokenEmbedder to get weighted combination of LM hidden states
build_elmo_with_fine_tuning: build an ElmoTokenEmbedder with tune_lm enabled and frozen layers for fine-tuning a language model
review_elmo_lm_states: review the _lm_states method to understand how forward and backward tower states are combined
test_elmo_sentence_boundaries: test the _with_sentence_boundaries method to add BOS and EOS tokens to input tensors
